versions.title: ToolKnit 桌面客户端首个公开测试版
content: 桌面客户端首发：Windows 原生 .exe 应用，安装即用，支持深色主题与 WebGL 动态背景
中英双语界面：一键切换中文/English，全部工具文案、提示与按钮均已完成本地化
蜘蛛精灵加载动画：页面切换与工具处理过程中加入专属蜘蛛吉祥物过渡动画
统一安装器：可视化安装向导，支持自定义安装路径、桌面快捷方式、开始菜单入口
PDF 工具箱：PDF 转图片、拆分、合并、压缩、旋转、加密/解密、格式转换、页码提取、水印处理
图片工具箱：格式转换、批量转换、压缩、批量压缩、图片去水印、裁剪、拼图
音频工具箱：格式转换、音频剪辑、音频提取、BPM 检测、声道处理
视频工具箱：格式转换、视频截图、视频压缩
文本工具箱：全角半角转换、文本反转、简繁转换、大小写转换、文本格式化
AI 创意助手：AI 翻译、AI 润色、AI 文档生成、AI 角色扮演
离线优先：所有工具不依赖网络，本地运行，隐私文件无需上传
拖拽处理：PDF、图片、音频、视频等文件支持拖拽导入，操作直观
批量处理：图片、音频等工具支持批量导入与一键导出

versions.title: AI 工具、文本工具与安装器集成
content: AI 翻译：支持多种语言互译，可切换正式/口语风格，适合文档与日常内容
AI 润色：支持对文本进行语法修正、语气优化与表达升级
AI 文档生成：根据主题与关键词自动生成结构化文档草稿
AI 角色扮演：支持设定角色身份，进行情景对话与内容创作
文本全角半角转换：支持中文标点在全角与半角之间快速切换
文本反转：支持整段文字倒序排列，可用于创意排版或简单加密
简繁转换：支持简体中文与繁体中文互相转换，适配不同地区用户
大小写转换：支持英文大小写切换、首字母大写、驼峰命名转换
文本格式化：支持去除多余空格、统一换行、JSON 格式化等常用处理
统一安装器：支持自定义安装路径、桌面快捷方式、开始菜单入口
安装器双源下载：中文用户优先从 RainS3 下载，英文用户优先从 R2 下载
安装语言选择：安装向导支持中文与英文界面，根据用户选择生成配置
蜘蛛精灵加载动画：页面切换与处理过程中加入专属蜘蛛吉祥物过渡动画
WebGL 动态背景：首页与关键页面加入深色流体动态背景，提升视觉体验
用户统计面板：首页显示总使用次数、个人使用次数与最近使用记录

versions.title: 音频与视频工具接入
content: 音频格式转换：支持 MP3、WAV、FLAC、AAC、OGG、M4A 等常见格式互转
音频批量转换：支持一次导入多个音频文件，统一设置输出格式、码率、采样率
音频剪辑：支持按起止时间精确裁剪音频片段，可试听并导出
音频提取：支持从视频文件中提取音频轨道，保存为 MP3 或 WAV
BPM 检测：支持自动分析音频节奏，显示每分钟节拍数
声道处理：支持单声道/立体声转换、左右声道分离与静音处理
视频格式转换：支持 MP4、AVI、MOV、MKV、WMV、FLV 等格式互转
视频压缩：支持按目标码率、目标大小或预设画质压缩视频
视频截图：支持从视频中提取指定时间点的帧，保存为高清图片
多媒体进度显示：转换过程中实时显示进度条、当前文件与剩余时间
取消任务支持：音频与视频转换过程中可随时中断，避免长时间等待
输出目录记忆：记住用户上次选择的输出目录，提升批量操作效率
批量文件列表：支持拖拽添加、移除、清空任务列表，支持排序与预览

versions.title: PDF 与图片工具原型验证
content: 桌面应用框架搭建：基于 Tauri 构建 Windows 原生客户端，实现 Rust 后端与 Web 前端的安全通信
深色主题与响应式布局：完成全局暗色 UI 设计，侧边栏导航、工具卡片、文件拖拽区域全部适配
PDF 转图片：支持按页批量将 PDF 转换为 PNG/JPG，可自定义输出分辨率与图片质量
PDF 拆分：支持按页数范围或按页数间隔将 PDF 拆分为多个独立文件
PDF 合并：支持拖拽多个 PDF 文件，按顺序合并为一个完整文档
PDF 压缩：通过图像重采样与对象清理降低 PDF 文件体积
PDF 旋转：支持单页或全部页面顺时针/逆时针旋转，并可保存为新文件
PDF 加密/解密：支持设置打开密码与权限密码，也可移除已有密码
PDF 页码提取：支持提取指定连续页或分散页组合成新 PDF
PDF 水印：支持添加文字或图片水印，可调整位置、透明度、旋转角度
图片格式转换：支持 JPG、PNG、WEBP、BMP、GIF、TIFF 等格式互转
图片批量转换：支持一次选择多个文件，统一输出格式与尺寸参数
图片压缩：支持按质量百分比或目标文件大小压缩，保留原格式
图片批量压缩：支持批量导入、统一设置压缩参数并一键导出
图片去水印：支持框选区域并基于邻近像素进行修复填补
图片裁剪：支持自由裁剪、固定比例裁剪与常用社交媒体尺寸预设
图片拼图：支持多图拼接，可选横向、纵向、宫格布局
文件拖拽导入：PDF 与图片工具均支持拖拽文件到工作区，自动识别并加载

versions.title: First Public Beta of ToolKnit Desktop
content: Desktop client debut: Native Windows .exe app, install and run, dark theme with WebGL dynamic background
Bilingual interface: One-click switch between Chinese/English, all tool labels, prompts and buttons localized
Spider mascot loading animation: Exclusive spider mascot transition animation during page switches and processing
Unified installer: Visual installation wizard with custom install path, desktop shortcut and start menu support
PDF toolkit: PDF to image, split, merge, compress, rotate, encrypt/decrypt, format conversion, page extraction, watermark
Image toolkit: Format conversion, batch conversion, compress, batch compress, watermark removal, crop, collage
Audio toolkit: Format conversion, audio clipping, audio extraction, BPM detection, channel processing
Video toolkit: Format conversion, video screenshot, video compression
Text toolkit: Full/half-width conversion, text reverse, simplified/traditional conversion, case conversion, text formatting
AI creative assistant: AI translation, AI polish, AI document generation, AI role play
Offline first: All tools run locally without network, no need to upload private files
Drag and drop: PDF, image, audio, video files support drag-and-drop import
Batch processing: Image, audio and other tools support batch import and one-click export

versions.title: AI Tools, Text Tools, and Installer Integration
content: AI translation: Support multilingual translation with formal/casual style switching for documents and daily content
AI polish: Grammar correction, tone optimization, and expression enhancement for text
AI document generation: Generate structured document drafts based on topics and keywords
AI role play: Set character identities for scenario dialogue and content creation
Full/half-width conversion: Quickly switch Chinese punctuation between full-width and half-width
Text reverse: Reverse the order of entire text for creative layout or simple encryption
Simplified/traditional conversion: Convert between Simplified and Traditional Chinese for different regions
Case conversion: Switch English case, capitalize first letters, and convert to camelCase
Text formatting: Remove extra spaces, unify line breaks, JSON formatting, and other common processing
Unified installer: Support custom install path, desktop shortcut, and start menu entry
Installer dual-source download: Chinese users prefer RainS3, English users prefer R2
Installer language selection: Installer supports Chinese and English interface, generates config based on user choice
Spider mascot loading animation: Exclusive spider mascot transition animation during page switches and processing
WebGL dynamic background: Dark fluid dynamic background added to home and key pages for better visual experience
User statistics panel: Home page displays total usage count, personal usage count, and recent usage records

versions.title: Audio and Video Tools Added
content: Audio format conversion: Convert between MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, and other formats
Audio batch conversion: Import multiple audio files and set unified output format, bitrate, and sample rate
Audio clipping: Precisely crop audio by start and end time, with preview and export
Audio extraction: Extract audio track from video files and save as MP3 or WAV
BPM detection: Automatically analyze audio rhythm and display beats per minute
Channel processing: Convert mono/stereo, separate left/right channels, and mute channels
Video format conversion: Convert between MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV, WMV, FLV, and other formats
Video compression: Compress video by target bitrate, target size, or preset quality
Video screenshot: Extract frames from video at specified timestamps and save as HD images
Real-time progress display: Show progress bar, current file, and remaining time during conversion
Cancel task support: Audio and video conversions can be interrupted at any time to avoid long waits
Output directory memory: Remember the last selected output directory for more efficient batch operations
Batch file list: Drag to add, remove, or clear tasks; support sorting and preview

versions.title: PDF and Image Tools Prototype
content: Desktop framework setup: Built native Windows client using Tauri with secure Rust backend and web frontend communication
Dark theme and responsive layout: Global dark UI design completed, sidebar navigation, tool cards, and drag-drop areas adapted
PDF to image: Convert PDF pages to PNG/JPG in batch with customizable resolution and quality
PDF split: Split PDF by page range or interval into multiple independent files
PDF merge: Drag and drop multiple PDFs to merge them into one document in order
PDF compress: Reduce PDF file size through image resampling and object cleanup
PDF rotate: Rotate single or all pages clockwise/counterclockwise and save as new file
PDF encrypt/decrypt: Set open password and permission password, or remove existing passwords
PDF page extraction: Extract specified continuous or scattered pages into a new PDF
PDF watermark: Add text or image watermarks with adjustable position, opacity, and rotation
Image format conversion: Convert between JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and more
Image batch conversion: Select multiple files and convert them all with unified output format and size
Image compress: Compress by quality percentage or target file size while preserving original format
Image batch compress: Import multiple images, set unified compression parameters, and export with one click
Image watermark removal: Select area and repair based on nearby pixels
Image crop: Free crop, fixed ratio crop, and preset social media sizes
Image collage: Combine multiple images horizontally, vertically, or in grid layout
Drag and drop import: PDF and image tools support dragging files into the workspace for automatic loading
